name: SafeHarbour Health Plan
disclaimer: FICTIONAL POLICY created for the PolicyGraph demo project. Not a real insurance product.

clauses.title: Pre-existing condition
clauses.text: "Pre-existing condition" means any illness, injury or condition whose signs or symptoms existed at any time in the 6 months before your cover started, whether or not it had been diagnosed.

clauses.title: Waiting period
clauses.text: "Waiting period" means the period from the start of your cover during which certain benefits are not available.

clauses.title: Approved hospital
clauses.text: "Approved hospital" means a hospital listed in the Approved Hospitals Directory for your plan, as published by us at the start of each policy year.

clauses.title: Cosmetic treatment
clauses.text: "Cosmetic treatment" means any treatment carried out mainly to change or improve your appearance rather than to treat an illness or injury.

clauses.title: Medically necessary
clauses.text: "Medically necessary" means treatment recommended by a consultant as appropriate and required for the diagnosis or treatment of an illness or injury.

clauses.title: Inpatient and day-case treatment
clauses.text: We will pay for medically necessary inpatient and day-case treatment in an approved hospital, including accommodation, nursing and consultant fees, subject to the waiting periods in Section 3 and the exclusions in Section 4.

clauses.title: Surgery
clauses.text: We will pay for medically necessary surgical procedures, including orthopaedic surgery such as knee and hip operations, carried out in an approved hospital.

clauses.title: Outpatient consultations
clauses.text: We will pay 50% of the cost of consultant outpatient visits, up to €1,000 per policy year.

clauses.title: Diagnostic scans
clauses.text: We will pay for MRI and CT scans when referred by a consultant and carried out at an approved centre.

clauses.title: Maternity
clauses.text: We will pay for inpatient maternity care in an approved hospital.

clauses.title: New illness
clauses.text: There is a waiting period of 26 weeks for treatment of any illness or condition that first appears after your cover started. Treatment for accidental injury is covered from the start of your cover.

clauses.title: Pre-existing conditions
clauses.text: There is a waiting period of 5 years for any treatment, including surgery, related to a pre-existing condition. During this period we will not pay for that treatment.

clauses.title: Maternity
clauses.text: There is a waiting period of 52 weeks for maternity benefits.

clauses.title: Cosmetic treatment
clauses.text: We do not pay for cosmetic treatment, unless it is reconstructive surgery following an accident or treatment for cancer that is covered under this plan.

clauses.title: Non-approved hospitals
clauses.text: We do not pay for any treatment received in a hospital that is not an approved hospital.

clauses.title: Treatment abroad
clauses.text: We do not pay for treatment received outside the Republic of Ireland.

clauses.title: Experimental treatment
clauses.text: We do not pay for experimental or unproven treatment, or for drugs not licensed for use in Ireland.

clauses.title: Pre-authorisation
clauses.text: You must obtain our approval before any scan or planned surgery. If you do not, we may reduce or refuse the claim.

clauses.title: Time limit for claims
clauses.text: You must submit your claim within 6 months of the date of treatment.

clauses.title: Excess
clauses.text: An excess of €150 applies to each inpatient stay.
